name: Nassau
type: city; capital city; administrative territorial entity; big city
text: Nassau ( NASS-aw) is the capital and largest city of the Bahamas. It is on the island of New Providence, which has a population of 296,522, 74.26% of the country's total population. Nassau is commonly defined as a primate city, dwarfing all other towns in the country.

depictions.name: Nassau
depictions.text: Nassau, Bahamas Nassau is the capital, largest city, and commercial center of the Bahamas, situated on the island of New Providence.
